title: Renuncia de Yoloxóchitl Bustamante Díez, directora general del IPN, como resultado del movimiento estudiantil del IPN.
text: Yoloxóchitl Bustamante Díez es una ingeniera bioquímica y profesora mexicana. Fue la primera mujer que se desempeñó como directora general del Instituto Politécnico Nacional en México.

title: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), la empresa de artes marciales mixtas más importante, celebra su primer evento en el país (llamado «UFC 180») en la Arena Ciudad de México.
text: Las artes marciales mixtas consisten en la combinación de técnicas que provienen de una gran variedad de artes marciales y deportes de combate. Si bien su uso principal es en la competición dentro del deporte de combate, estas técnicas también pueden ser aplicadas para la defensa personal.

title: Se lleva a cabo un homenaje público en el estadio azteca entre otros lugares para despedir al comediante Roberto Gómez Bolaños «Chespirito» fallecido en la ciudad de Cancún el 28 de noviembre.
text: Roberto Mario Gómez Bolaños, conocido como Chespirito, fue un actor, comediante, guionista, director y productor mexicano. Es considerado una de las figuras más influyentes del entretenimiento televisivo en América Latina durante el siglo XX, gracias a la creación e interpretación de personajes emblemáticos como El Chavo del 8 y El Chapulín Colorado.

title: Alpine skier Hubertus von Hohenlohe-Langenburg sets the record for the longest span of competing at the Winter Olympic Games, at 30 years.
text: Hubertus Rudolph Prinz zu Hohenlohe-Langenburg, commonly known as Hubertus von Hohenlohe, is a Mexican alpine skier, photographer, and businessman. He was previously a pop singer using the names Andy Himalaya and Royal Disaster.

title: March 2–9 – The 2014 Pan American Ice Hockey Tournament take place in Mexico City.
text: The 2014 Pan American Ice Hockey Tournament was the first Pan American Ice Hockey Tournament, an annual event run by the Federación Deportiva de México de Hockey sobre Hielo. It took place in Mexico City, Mexico between March 2 and March 9, 2014.

title: 36 people are killed after the bus in which they were travelling crashed in Acayucan, Veracruz.
text: On April 13, 2014, shortly after midnight, a bus traveling from Villahermosa to Mexico City collided with a broken-down truck and caught fire, killing at least 36 people, all of whom were merchants from the Veracruz and Tabasco states. There were four survivors, which managed to escape the flames by exiting through the back of the bus.

title: A 7.5-magnitude earthquake hits near Petatlán, Guerrero.
text: The 2014 Guerrero earthquake occurred with a moment magnitude of 7.2–7.3 that hit the state of Guerrero, close to Acapulco, Mexico, on 18 April at 14:27:26 UTC.

title: Galindo Mellado Cruz, one of the founding members of the Mexican drug cartel Los Zetas, and four other armed men are killed in a shootout with Mexican security forces after they raided Cruz's hideout in the city of Reynosa.
text: Los Zetas is a fractured Mexican criminal syndicate and designated terrorist organization, known as one of the most dangerous of Mexico's drug cartels. They are known for engaging in brutally violent "shock and awe" tactics such as beheadings, torture, and indiscriminate murder.

title: 27 August–September: CENAPRED reported explosions of Popocateptl, accompanied by steam-and-gas emissions with minor ash and ash plumes that rose 800-3,000 m above the volcano's crater, which drifted west, southwest, and west-southwest. On…
text: Popocatépetl is an active stratovolcano located in the states of Puebla, Morelos, and Mexico in central Mexico. It lies in the eastern half of the Trans-Mexican Volcanic Belt.

title: Hurricane Odile reaches Category 4 strength as it nears Mexico's Baja California coast.
text: Hurricane Odile was a powerful and destructive Pacific hurricane that is tied for the most intense landfalling tropical cyclone in the Baja California Peninsula during the satellite era. Odile inflicted widespread damage, particularly in the Mexico state of Baja California Sur, in addition to causing lesser impacts on the Mexican mainland and Southwestern United States.

title: The biographical film Cantinflas, about the Mexican actor of the same name, is released in Mexico.
text: Mario Fortino Alfonso Moreno Reyes, known by the stage name Cantinflas (Spanish pronunciation: ), was a Mexican comedian, actor, and filmmaker. He is considered to have been the most widely accomplished Mexican comedian and is well known throughout Latin America and Spain.

title: 6 students from the Raúl Isidro Burgos Rural Teachers College of Ayotzinapa are killed and 43 more disappear after a protest and a confrontation with Iguala, Guerrero police officers.
text: Raúl Isidro Burgos Rural Normal School, commonly known as the Ayotzinapa Rural Normal School, is a men's normal school, located in the municipality of Tixtla, Guerrero, Mexico. The school is part of the rural teacher's education system that was created as part of an ambitious mass education plan implemented by the state in the 1920s.

title: Nuestra Belleza México 2014 takes place.
text: Nuestra Belleza México 2014, the 21st annual Nuestra Belleza México beauty pageant, was held at the Jardines de México in Jojutla, Morelos, Mexico on October 25, 2014. Thirty-two contestants of the Mexican Republic competed for the national title, which was won by Wendolly Esparza from Aguascalientes who later competed in Miss Universe 2015 in the United States, where she was a semifinalist in the Top 15.

title: Former Beltrán Leyva Cartel leader Alfredo Beltrán Leyva is extradited to the United States from Mexico, facing drug trafficking and money laundering offences.
text: Alfredo Beltrán Leyva, commonly referred to by his alias El Mochomo (The Desert Ant), is a Mexican convicted drug lord and former leader of the Beltrán-Leyva Cartel, a drug trafficking organization. He was one of Mexico's most-wanted drug lords.

title: The number of Chikungunya cases in Chiapas increases from 14 to 39 in one week. Between 17,000 and 18,000 cases have been reported by the Pan American Health Organization.
text: Chikungunya is an infection caused by the chikungunya virus. The most common symptoms are fever and joint pain, typically occurring four to eight days after the bite of an infected mosquito.
